basis_note: Applies the operator's Structural Harm Mechanism (SHM) Catalogue - a set of named institutional-dysfunction patterns built by the operator from pattern detection across past cases - against this case's own frozen DFAPTA cross-pattern analysis (EV-0001-EV-0827, frozen per DEC-0009). The catalogue is applied only to evidence already gathered; it played no role in what evidence was collected. A mechanism is listed as Applied only where this case's own DFAPTA paths (produced before the catalogue was cross-referenced against them) already contain a matching finding with real EV- citations. Nothing here goes beyond what those paths already established.
catalogue_reference: Structural Harm Mechanism Catalogue v2.0 (operator-authored, 68 named mechanisms; this gate cites 7)
position_in_chain: Applied after DFAPTA (Stage 2), before Lattice Atlas (Stage 3) - a known-patterns check against frozen evidence, distinct from Lattice Atlas's search for new, not-yet-named emergent patterns.

root_finding.title: Documented Compliance vs. Functional Compliance
root_finding.statement: The six applied mechanisms below are not six independent findings. Looked at together, all six are the same root distinction wearing different faces: what the record documents does not match what is functionally true, and no single rule was broken producing that gap. Mechanism 9 is the named instance of the distinction itself. Three of the remaining five explain why the gap stays uncheckable; one explains how the documented side gets built for public consumption; one shows the same gap running on a clock instead of a claim. Presented separately below for citation precision, but the root finding is one thing, not six.

roles.role_note: The exact contradiction, formally frozen as CTR-0001: documented as reactive and "not surveillance"; functionally proactive, covert flying was part of the plan.

roles.role_label: Why the gap stays uncheckable (1 of 3)
roles.role_note: No single source exists to compare the documented claim against the functional reality - the record needed to check it was never designed to be assembled in one place.

roles.role_label: Why the gap stays uncheckable (2 of 3)
roles.role_note: The material to check the gap exists and is technically public, but verifying it costs more analytical effort than almost anyone checking a petition or a press release can spend.

roles.role_label: Why the gap stays uncheckable (3 of 3)
roles.role_note: The institution controls the terms its own documented compliance is measured against, so it can keep the documented side looking settled without the functional side ever being independently defined.

roles.role_label: How the documented side gets built
roles.role_note: The public-facing claim is compressed past the point of being checkable before it ever reaches a signatory or a reader - the compression is what makes the documented side look clean.

roles.role_label: The same gap, running on a clock
roles.role_note: Documented: a six-month trial. Functional: still running past seven months, no stated end condition. No rule was broken, because no rule existed to break.

applied.name: Opacity by Design
applied.definition: The system cannot be independently examined - not because records are hidden, but because the system was designed without the structural features that would make independent examination possible. The mechanism is not concealment - it is the absence of auditability as a design feature.
applied.match_note: The single most repeated match in this case. Eight of twenty-two DFAPTA paths independently tagged the same pattern (as 'Opacity by Design' or 'confirmed for public reconstruction') without reference to the catalogue: the evidentiary picture is distributed across 12 snapshots, a 763-question bank, two answer registers, a GIPA pack and an AE register with no single reconstructable source (AR-001); aggregate arrest/vehicle/missing-person totals cannot be reproduced from any primary dataset (AR-004); the complete Moree cost model is not publicly disclosed (AR-005); no AI Assessment Framework determination for PolAir-Remote has been located (AR-012); two overlapping procurement instruments and their relationship are not documented in one place (AR-013); no PolAir-Remote-specific evidence-handling protocol has been located (AR-019); secondary-use/retention/child-and-Indigenous-specific governance documents are not publicly located (AR-020); a complete GIPA acquisition plan exists precisely because the underlying records were never publicly reconstructable (AR-021).

applied.name: Narrative Compression
applied.definition: Complex structural conditions are reduced to simplified framings that omit the elements that would trigger accountability. The mechanism is the selection of language that is technically accurate at the compressed level while functionally concealing what is occurring at the structural level.
applied.match_note: Five paths independently found the same compression pattern: the petition presents six numeric claims as settled fact without disclosing that the underlying evaluation, cost model or deployment architecture do not yet exist in public form (AR-002); a multi-year regional offending trend and a six-month technology trial are compressed into a single causal headline (AR-003); '30 to 60 second deployment' reads as a police response-time claim when it is a launch/availability metric (AR-007); a victim's expression of fear can be read as implicit endorsement of a specific surveillance technology without the full source article (AR-009); 'solely used for crime' compresses a program whose own commencement briefing described broader emergency functions (AR-011).

applied.name: Documented Compliance as Shield
applied.definition: The institution points to the process it completed as evidence that the obligation was met. The process was completed. The outcome the process was supposed to produce was not achieved. Documented compliance substituted for functional compliance.
applied.status: APPLIED - tied to a formal contradiction
applied.match_note: NSW Police's formal launch messaging (19 February 2026) describes PolAir-Remote as reactive, incident-response capability and explicitly 'not surveillance'. Contemporaneous January 2026 reporting describes the same program flying proactively and conducting covert aerial exercises as part of its planned operating model - a reassuring public label functioning alongside an undisclosed broader operating mode. This is not a loose analogy; it is the same contradiction already frozen in the case's own Contradiction Register as CTR-0001.

applied.name: Complexity as Barrier
applied.definition: The governance instrument is not hidden. It is published, available, technically accessible. But its language, structure, and cross-referencing make it functionally illegible to the population it governs. The barrier is not secrecy - it is density.
applied.match_note: The case's own evidentiary picture is itself an instance of the pattern it investigates: 12 snapshots, a 763-question bank, two answer registers, a GIPA pack and an AE register, none reconstructable as a single accessible account (AR-001). Separately, disentangling PolAir-Remote's specific contribution to Moree's crime trend from several overlapping, mechanistically-related interventions (Operation Soteria, s 22C bail reform) requires analytical resources beyond what a public petition or press release can supply (AR-006).

applied.name: Definitional Control
applied.definition: The institution defines the terms under which its own performance is assessed. Key terms are undefined in any publicly available document. The institution sets the standard, measures against the standard, and reports compliance with the standard.
applied.match_note: The petition's undefined '50% drop in crime' and the closest verified statistic (a 53% youth-legal-action decline since 2022, using narrower parameters) are presented as if interchangeable, with no disclosed offence definition, geography, age group or baseline (AR-003). Separately, 'Kemp's bail laws' is a widely used but factually imprecise label for a statute (s 22C) enacted by a different government from a different, narrower proposal - a label this investigation does not adopt (AR-008).

applied.name: Time as Structural Harm Mechanism
applied.definition: Delay, silence, deferral, queueing, response latency. The institution does not refuse. It waits. The citizen's capacity to sustain the complaint erodes. The evidence ages. The political window closes. The harm compounds while the process continues.
applied.status: APPLIED - interpretive bridge from a locally-named finding
applied.match_note: This case's own DFAPTA path named this pattern independently as 'Technology Ratchet' before the catalogue was cross-referenced against it: the Moree trial was publicly described as running six months from 8 January 2026, yet PolAir-Remote assisted an arrest arising from a 2 August 2026 incident - nearly seven months later - with no located public notice of an extension, and no public material specifies a threshold at which the program would be judged unsuccessful and stopped. The case's own finding does not claim irreversibility is proven; it names a continuation-and-expansion risk with no visible exit gate. Flagged here as an interpretive bridge, not an exact terminology match, because the case's own label ('Technology Ratchet') is more specific than the catalogue's generic name and is preserved as the primary finding language.

risk_provisional.name: Consultation as Legitimation
risk_provisional.definition: The institution consults the affected population. The consultation produces submissions. The submissions are noted. The policy proceeds unchanged. The consultation record now serves as evidence of engagement regardless of whether the consultation altered the outcome.
risk_provisional.status: RISK - not confirmed by this case's own standard
risk_provisional.match_note: Moree's public consultation on the RPAS system closed in June 2026, five months after the system was already operational, and the enterprise RPAS Panel EOI was published before that consultation had even closed - material technical configuration was fixed before public input was sought. The case's own path (AR-015) explicitly declines to confirm this as the mechanism: 'consultation occurring after material decisions are made can still be genuine input into future iterations; the register does not establish which is the case here.' Carried here as a named risk, not a finding, out of respect for that existing hedge.

candidate_new_mechanisms.definition_from_case: A real complaint mechanism exists, with clear statutory jurisdiction covering systemic (not only individual-conduct) concerns. The practical accountability gap is not the absence of a complaint mechanism - it is that a resident who suspects a drone observed their property has no obvious way to discover whether a specific flight occurred, and therefore no practical trigger to invoke the complaint mechanisms that do exist.
candidate_new_mechanisms.note: Checked against all 68 named mechanisms in Catalogue v2.0; no clean match found. The closest neighbours - Standing Exclusion by Design (#47, describes absence of standing) and Standing Grant as Token (#63, describes standing neutralised by procedural terms) - both describe standing that exists but cannot produce effect. This case's finding (AR-016) is different in kind: standing and jurisdiction are both real and adequate; what fails is the citizen's ability to discover the triggering fact needed to invoke them. Surfaced here as a genuine candidate for the operator's own further catalogue development, per the catalogue's own stated growth method (discovery through investigation), not adopted into this case's applied findings.

not_claimed: This gate does not claim the Structural Harm Mechanism Catalogue's other 61 mechanisms are absent from PolAir-Remote governance - only that this case's own frozen DFAPTA analysis did not surface matching findings for them.
This gate does not claim intent by any named individual or agency. Every mechanism above is a structural/behavioural description, consistent with this case's own non-allegatory standard.

The 'Time as Structural Harm Mechanism' match (AR-014) is an interpretive bridge from a locally-coined finding, not an exact terminology match in the original path - flagged accordingly, not presented as a stronger match than it is.
The candidate new mechanism (Standing Without Discoverability) is not yet part of the operator's catalogue. It is offered as a discovery finding, not asserted as canon.
This gate does not re-open or re-verify the underlying EV- items. Every citation here inherits the same verification_state "Unverified" status the whole frozen register carries (DEC-0001).
